title: corymbis disticha
intro: Corymbis disticha, commonly known as Mexican Sage, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Corymbis disticha include its use as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to soothe various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
